title: Emergency Kit
bodyHtml:
Back in a time when the world felt closed off,
we found freedom through creativity.

We painted, played music, wrote stories, danced, and sewed clothes.
We created not just for ourselves, but for each other:
concerts, exhibitions, little gifts of art that carried emotion through dark times.

One of those gifts was a painting of a cat named Sonja.
The artist’s roommate. A muse. A companion.
That painting still hangs on the wall today,
carrying memories of resilience, expression, and friendship.

What if we all had an "emergency kit" at home?
A few paints, brushes, or even just a notebook.
Something you can reach for when life feels too heavy.

You don’t need to be an artist.
You just need to express.
That’s the real magic.
